title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30

ai_review.summary: Audience tape captures an energetic 6/30/73 show with a roaring Promised Land, but the mud‑dy, noise‑reduced sound limits clarity.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as lively and well‑played, opening with a powerful The Promised Land that sets a high‑energy tone for the night. Recording quality is mixed – some listeners describe it as smooth, while others note noticeable muddiness and loss of high‑end detail due to noise reduction. Overall the show shines despite the less‑than‑ideal audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated high (energetic, well played) while recording quality receives mixed feedback (smooth vs muddy/NR). Weighted average of reviewer stars (~3.0) adjusted for strong performance yields a ~3.5‑4 rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note the tape is smooth in parts but overall muddy and lacking high‑end presence, likely due to noise reduction or tape age.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, energetic opening that maintains momentum throughout the set.
